notes.title: 0.0.0.8 Update
notes.notes:
0.0.0.8
Fixed issue where hair physics wouldn’t initiate properly in some cases. Actually got to submit an unreal engine bug for that, but I also figured out a workaround.

Tweaked the character creation UI for better appearance

Adjusted hair placement on male characters

Removed dual hair slots due to issues with physics as noted above but streamlined the way hair assets can be implemented so it’s not all manual work, can just create them and add them to the array

Created inventory slots in save games - actual saved inventory to come

Fixed mouselook activating in character creation UI

Added muscle customization

Added body build customization

Greatly improved “landing” time so you’re not floating around for so long while the world loads.

Added breast size customization

notes.title: Update 0.0.0.4

notes.title: Version 0.0.0.2
notes.notes:
We basically completely rebuilt the game. There was issue with the way the voxel world used the resource pool and the way the level streaming works that made it impossible to interact with world items.

So we did that and then added in the new characters, seed options, inventory, etc.

It's obviously still not an actual working game.
